title: Kidney scan (renal scintigraphy)
what: A very small dose of a radioactive substance is given into a vein, and a gamma camera shows how each kidney works separately.
why: When it is important to know how much each kidney works, for reflux in children, narrowing of the urinary tract, and before operations.
duration: usually 30 to 60 minutes; for some types of scan a repeat image is needed after a few hours; the report comes the same day or in 1 to 2 days
tell_doctor: If you might be pregnant or are breastfeeding
What medicines you take, especially water pills and blood pressure pills
For a child: weight and height

prepare.title: Water
prepare.text: Usually you are asked to drink water about an hour before the scan. The clinic will say how much.

prepare.title: Medicines
prepare.text: Sometimes you are asked to pause certain blood pressure pills. Do not stop them on your own. The doctor decides.

prepare.title: Toilet
prepare.text: Go to the toilet before the scan.

bring: For a child: a diaper and a toy
steps: You drink water as the clinic said
You lie on the table under the gamma camera
A small dose of the substance is given into a vein
The camera records images while you lie still for 20 to 40 minutes
Sometimes a water pill is given and more images are taken
Sometimes you are asked to come back for a repeat image
feel: A needle prick in the vein, like a regular blood test
The scan itself does not hurt
Lying still can be hard, especially for a child
after: Drink more water and go to the toilet more often that day
Wash your hands after using the toilet
For a day, try not to hold small children or pregnant women close for long. Check with the clinic
If you are breastfeeding, you may be advised to pause for a while. Ask the doctor
red_flags: Rash, swelling of the face, trouble breathing: call your local emergency number
Severe lower back pain or blood in the urine

faq.a: The dose is small and leaves the body quickly in the urine. A doctor orders it when the benefit outweighs the risk.

faq.q: Can I be with my child during the scan?
faq.a: Yes, a parent usually stays close and helps the child lie calmly.

reminders.text: Kidney scan tomorrow. In the morning drink water as the clinic said. Ask your doctor about blood pressure pills.
